message: As a busy parent, I know how crucial it is to have a plan in place—especially when technology can fail us at the worst possible moment. Having a backup plan for emergencies can really save the day, whether it’s a power outage or a sudden storm. If you haven't yet thought about your family's emergency plan, I encourage you to check out some helpful resources. What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared when tech lets you down? 🌟
